paper_title: Unconjugated Side-Chain Engineering Enables Small Molecular Acceptors for Highly Efficient Non-Fullerene Organic Solar Cells: Insights into the Fine-Tuning of Acceptor Properties and Micromorphology
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Adv Funct Materials - 2019 - Liu - Unconjugated Side‐Chain Engineering Enables Small Molecular Acceptors for Highly/auto/Adv Funct Materials - 2019 - Liu - Unconjugated Side‐Chain Engineering Enables Small Molecular Acceptors for Highly.md

knowledge_points.content: The study utilizes an unconjugated side-chain strategy by attaching vertical aromatic moieties (thiophene, thieno[3,2-b]thiophene, or benzene) to a ladder-type benzo[1,2-b:4,5-b'] di(cyclopenta[2,1-b:3,4-b']dithiophene (BDCD) core to create small molecule acceptors (SMAs).
knowledge_points.evidence: In this work, we implemented side-chain engineering on BDCD by employing frequently used thiophene, thieno[3,2-b]thiophene and benzene as building moieties, and designed and synthesized three new fused-ring electron acceptors, namely, BTTIC-Th, BTTIC-TT, and BTTIC-Ph.

knowledge_points.content: Organic solar cells based on the PBDB-T:BTTIC-TT blend achieved a peak power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 13.44%, with an open-circuit voltage (Voc) of 0.924 V, short-circuit current (Jsc) of 19.61 mA cm^-2, and fill factor (FF) of 74.2%.
knowledge_points.evidence: OSCs based on PBDB-T:BTTIC-TT realized a higher PCE of 13.44% with three slightly higher parameters (a Voc of 0.924 V, Jsc of 19.61 mA cm^-2, and an FF of 74.2%).

knowledge_points.content: The LUMO energy levels of the SMAs are modulated by the strength of the δ-inductive effect between the vertical aromatic side chains and the electron-rich core; BTTIC-Ph (-3.78 eV) and BTTIC-TT (-3.80 eV) exhibit higher LUMO levels than BTTIC-Th (-3.90 eV).
knowledge_points.evidence: The LUMOs/HOMOs of BTTIC-Th, BTTIC-TT, and BTTIC-Ph were determined to be -3.90 eV/-5.49 eV, -3.80 eV/-5.54 eV, and -3.78 eV/-5.48 eV, respectively... The weaker electron-donating ability of benzene than that of thieno[3,2-b]thiophene further lessens the δ-inductive effect and therefore promotes the LUMO energy level.

knowledge_points.content: Aromatic side groups in these SMAs are considered 'unconjugated' because steric hindrance forces them into a twisted configuration relative to the backbone, preventing π-electron overlap and interrupting conjugation.
knowledge_points.evidence: Clearly, the aromatic side groups are forced to take the twisted configuration relative to the fused-ring backbone without HOMO and LUMO distributed on them, suggesting that the p-electrons (π electrons) between aromatic side chains and the fused-ring skeleton... do not overlap at all, and thus the conjugation is interrupted. According to these features, we called them unconjugated side chain.

knowledge_points.content: The organic solar cell devices were fabricated using a conventional structure of ITO/PEDOT:PSS/PBDB-T:Acceptor/ZrAcac/Al.
knowledge_points.evidence: OSC devices with a structure of indium tin oxide (ITO)/poly(3,4- ethylenedioxythiophene):poly(styrenesulfonate)(PEDOT:PSS)/ PBDB-T:acceptor/zirconium acetylacetonate (ZrAcac)/Al were fabricated.

knowledge_points.content: Resonant soft X-ray scattering (RSoXS) revealed that the PBDB-T:BTTIC-TT blend has the smallest domain size (15.3 nm), while PBDB-T:BTTIC-Ph has the largest domain size (26.3 nm), which hinders exciton dissociation.
knowledge_points.evidence: The domain sizes of PBDB-T:BTTIC-Th, PBDB-T:BTTIC-TT, and PBDB-T:BTTIC-Ph blend films calculated from the RSoXS profiles... are 19.6, 15.3, and 26.3 nm, respectively... the domain size of 26.3 nm for the PBDB-T:BTTIC-Ph blend film lowers the probability for excitons to reach the donor-acceptor interface.

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS analysis showed that BTTIC-Ph neat and blend films exhibit two distinct (010) diffraction halos in the out-of-plane direction (at ~1.52 and ~1.73 Å^-1), indicating the presence of multiple, disordered types of π-π stacking.
knowledge_points.evidence: It can be obviously observed from Figure 5c,f that there are two (010) diffraction halos for BTTIC-Ph neat and blend films in the qz direction at about 1.6 Å^-1. This phenomenon indicates that different types of π-π stacking exist in BTTIC-Ph neat and blend films, which is not conducive to efficient carrier transport.

knowledge_points.content: The energy loss (Eloss) for the PBDB-T:BTTIC-TT device is calculated to be 0.550 eV, which is significantly lower than the typical 0.6 eV threshold for high-performance organic solar cells.
knowledge_points.evidence: In this work, the Eloss of three SMAs-based OSCs are all lower than 0.6 eV... Impressively, OSCs based on PBDB-T:BTTIC-TT realized a PCE of 13.44% with an Eloss of 0.55 eV.

knowledge_points.content: Optimal device performance was achieved using a 1:1 donor-to-acceptor weight ratio, 0.25% 1,8-diiodooctane (DIO) as a solvent additive, and thermal annealing at 100°C.
knowledge_points.evidence: The optimal D:A weight ratio was 1:1... 1,8-Diiodooctane (DIO) was used as solvent additive (0.25%) during solution preparation and a thermal annealing (100 °C) step was performed after film formation.

knowledge_points.content: BTTIC-TT exhibits the highest electron mobility among the three studied SMAs in neat films, with a value of 9.28 × 10^-4 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1 measured by the space charge limited current (SCLC) method.
knowledge_points.evidence: The electron mobilities (μe) of BTTIC-Th, BTTIC-TT, and BTTIC-Ph neat films are 8.87 × 10^-4, 9.28 × 10^-4, and 7.28 × 10^-4 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1, respectively.
